threejs-atmosphere-aerial-perspective.rationale: Sky, shell, and surface-segment scattering must be visibly coupled to the same atmosphere parameters.

threejs-bloom.rationale: Selective contribution ownership and guaranteed material restoration are exercised by the sculpted gallery-frame example.

threejs-camera-direction.rationale: The reviewed camera systems are transform, state, and lifecycle logic with exact constants and pseudocode; the author explicitly accepted prose-only coverage.

threejs-exposure-color-grading.rationale: The reviewed post path is fully specified as meter dimensions, encoding, readback, adaptation constants, tone-map ownership, LUT generation, and diagnostics.

threejs-image-pipeline.rationale: This skill owns signal contracts and ordering across atomic effects; practical pass graphs and ownership tables are the directly applicable artifact.

threejs-precipitation-surfaces.rationale: Precipitation systems depend on visible coupling between particles, surface masks, normals, roughness, splashes, and weather progress; runnable examples are required to verify those relationships.

threejs-procedural-animation.rationale: The reviewed procedural motion systems are exact phase, frame, spring, and quaternion algorithms; the author explicitly accepted prose-only coverage.

threejs-procedural-architecture.rationale: Massing, exposed-edge analysis, façade grammar, semantic modules, and grouped mesh emission require implementation evidence.

threejs-procedural-fields.rationale: Coupled fields, masks, displacement, and procedural normals need inspectable shader implementation.

threejs-procedural-geometry.rationale: Complete hard-surface assemblies, vehicle- and humanoid-scale lofts, pillow panels, exact cuts, apertures, shell and fin construction, profile sweeps, branch rings, and semantic mesh compilation require implementation evidence; the portable JavaScript modeling and quality-gate assets add directly runnable topology, coplanar, clash, contract, and assembly checks.

threejs-procedural-materials.rationale: Material identity must be demonstrated under real geometry and lighting, including coupled texture-backed PBR and procedural channels, transmissive bodies, wavelength-dependent optics, and a deforming softbody whose geometry, thickness, absorption, shadow, and caustic fields share one physical state.

threejs-procedural-planets.rationale: Spherical domain warping, geological bands, biome masks, and orbit-to-close shading require a runnable implementation.

threejs-procedural-vegetation.rationale: Growth hierarchy, branch topology, foliage normals, virtual flower reconstruction, hierarchical GPU culling, distance-tiered plant geometry, and rooted wind require runnable implementation evidence.

threejs-procedural-vfx.rationale: Layered shells, finite-footprint emissive slabs, uniform ray integration, finite optical ghost families, field-angle pupil deformation, localized glare, wakes, sparks, pooling, additive rim-shell projections, and coupled volumetric velocity, dye, pressure, collision, and HDR contribution fields require runnable evidence.

threejs-raymarched-space-effects.rationale: Numerical curved-ray integration, adaptive geodesic step policy, observer transport through a throat, geodesic termination, disk crossings, volumetric disk accumulation, and footprint-filtered background sampling all require inspectable implementation.

threejs-screen-space-ambient-occlusion.rationale: The source extraction contains exact buffer contracts, equations, sampling, reconstruction, and diagnostics; the author accepted practical post-processing references without mandatory standalone examples.

threejs-shadow-systems.rationale: Clipmap coverage, texel snapping, cache state, cross-fades, and invalidation need a visible inspection surface.

threejs-skill-router.rationale: Routing metadata does not author graphics; it is verified by route reachability, ambiguity checks, and forward tests.

threejs-parallax-occlusion-mapping.rationale: Adaptive height marching, silhouette coverage, curved sag, shell inflation, self-shadowing, and relief-aware shadow depth require runnable TSL implementation evidence.

threejs-spectral-ocean.rationale: Spectral synthesis, staged FFTs, derivatives, persistent foam, hybrid refraction, exact dielectric Snell/TIR optics with forward-projected structures, and full underwater-medium optics are implementation-critical.

threejs-temporal-surfaces.rationale: Ping-pong history, static structure, layered procedural droplets, optical normals, blur, and refraction are implementation-critical.

threejs-visual-validation.rationale: The repository gallery, deterministic capture workflow, diagnostics, metrics, and smoke tests are the executable implementation of this skill.

threejs-volumetric-clouds.rationale: Density shaping, bounded integration, lighting, reconstruction, and shadows require runnable shader evidence.

threejs-water-optics.rationale: Bounded heightfield displacement, shared simulated normals, pool-volume refraction, absorption, caustics, and interaction coupling require runnable shader evidence.
